headline: Main strategy is up $3,378 on 2 of 2 winning bets, but only 18 markets have resolved, so nothing is established yet; the market price is still our best forecaster overall.
went_well: Main (Jev + Claude research) won both settled bets and is up $3,377.58. Two bets is luck-sized, not proof.
Claude direct scored a Brier of 0.097 against the market's 0.112, but it was judged on only 8 markets, possibly not the same ones.
Jev + research scored a Brier of 0.119 on 10 markets, far better than Jev alone at 0.336 on 18, so the research step looks like it matters.
went_badly: We are not beating the market: it scored 0.112 on all 18 resolved markets, and Jev + research (0.119, n=10) did not clearly beat it. In crypto (6 markets) the market scored 0.055 against research's 0.130.
Jev alone scored a Brier of 0.336 on 18 markets. That is worse than answering 50% every time (0.25), and it was worst in sports at 0.408 (n=9).

Of this week's reviewed outcomes, 2 misses were overconfidence and 2 of the 3 wins were judged lucky. The bold strategy is 1 for 3 with 25 bets still open, and the self-calibrating strategy can't start until 30 resolved markets exist (it has 10).

These strategies look at many of the same markets, so this is fewer inde

headline: A losing day for most strategies. Only main is ahead, at +$483 on 8 settled bets. Every Jev forecast still scores worse than the market price, and every sample here is too small to call.
went_well: Main is up $483 on 8 settled bets (4 wins, 4 losses). On the yardstick, main made +$1,173 and original +$1,136 on the same 11 bets, but only 4 have settled, so that is a tie and says nothing yet about the crypto skip.
The info gate appears to be saving money. Markets it stopped for main would have lost $44 per $100 staked (37 markets), and for Jev alone $60 per $100 (58 markets).

Claude direct's forecasts score a Brier of 0.131 (33 resolved), against 0.135 for the market price (120 resolved). The two are not scored on the same markets, so this is a hint, not proof, that Claude matches the market.
went_badly: Claude direct has lost all 4 of its settled bets, for -$8,000, despite having the best Brier score. Four bets is noise, but it suggests the gaps it bets on are its own errors rather than real edge.
Bold is down $8,545 all time (4 wins, 10 losses) and has lost all 3 bets settled since its info threshold rose to 0.35 (-$5,424). Jev alone, bold, is down $7,552 with 1 win in 6.

We are not beating the market. By Brier score, the market is at 0.135, Jev + research at 0.199 (82 resolved), Jev alone at 0.266 (120) and self-calibrating Jev at 0.236 (22). Calibration seems to make Jev worse. In economy, Jev + research scores 0.337 against the market's 0.168 (11 resolved).

headline: A quiet half-day (7 new bets): every strategy is still below its starting $100k, and the market's own price still out-forecasts all of our forecasters.
went_well: The self-calibrating strategy is the least-bad strategy that bets: down $4.3k all time on 9 settled. It has won all 5 of its bets on favourites (60c and up), for +$3.6k. That is far too few to call an edge.
Since the 30c price floor began on 2026-10-01, 'Jev alone, bold' has settled one bet and won it, for +$2.7k. One result tells us nothing yet.
No new long-shot losses: since the floor, no strategy has settled a bet under 30c. Before the floor, long shots had lost $70.7k across strategies, with 2 wins in 42.
went_badly: The floor hasn't turned anything profitable yet. Since 2026-10-01 the seven strategies that bet have settled 12 bets between them: 5 wins, net -$7.7k. Many of these are the same markets, and 12 is noise.
Tuning main hasn't paid so far. On the bets both placed since original started, main is at -$6.4k (9 settled) and the untuned original is at -$1.9k (11 settled). That is still well under 30 settled.

No forecaster beats the market. On the 191 markets all were scored on, the market's Brier score (lower is better) is 0.150, Claude direct 0.177, Jev + research 0.201 and Jev alone 0.241. Claude direct's own bets are 0 for 6, -$11.6k.
